title: Internal: closing a demurrage and detention record as settled
content:
## Situation of use and capability

Within the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, this tool closes one container's free-time record as settled with today's date. The desk marks the record settled and stamps today as its settlement date; nothing is booked on the account and the balance shown is left as it stands. The customer then sees the record as settled.

## How it is invoked

The tool is **settle_dnd_record_d9ada3ba**, an internal tool that the agent must first unlock (through unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then call (through call_agent_discoverable_tool).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| dnd_id | Reference number of the free-time record being closed, as returned by the free-time record lookup | identifier |

## Return

A successful call answers "Record (record reference) settled on (YYYY-MM-DD) with balance due USD (balance)." The date is today's date and the balance is the record's outstanding amount in USD to 2 decimal places. An answer starting with "Error:" means no record exists under that reference and nothing changed.

## Contract questions

**Q: Does settling the record change its balance?**
A: No. Nothing is booked on the account; the balance shown is left as it stands and is reported in the answer.

**Q: Which settlement date is stamped?**
A: Today's date.
